cards.text: Three years walking in freedom now. The ache never fully leaves, but I've learned the ache is my teacher.

cards.author: Priya
cards.text: I still stumble in my thoughts sometimes. But my mentor says the stumble is part of the walk. Grateful for this room.

cards.author: Deb M.
cards.text: To the newer sisters: it gets quieter. Not silent — quieter. That's the promise I can honestly make.
